title: Mixed Event — On This Holy Night, I Sing — Episode6 Enchantment

meta.Event: On This Holy Night, I Sing
meta.Event Outline: For their second show for the Show Contest, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS are preparing a Christmas-themed musical! However, a prima donna with a voice powerful enough to shock even Nene stands in their path...! Curtains open for these two songstresses as they each put their pride on the line!

rows.Line: Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sigh... We spent so much time chatting, I didn't get to sing at all. We really don't have the time to do that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well, you can see mine whenever you want!
My parents recorded all of them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think my parents also have some recordings of me practicing, and my theater troupe's events too.

rows.Speaker: Nene's Voice
rows.Line:
Mom!
Can I ask you something?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
This should be the right one...
I just have to skip forward a bit...

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: I'm going to start now. Okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene's Mom
rows.Line: Okay. Go on, dear!

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: Would you like to fly into the sky with me?

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: Don't be afraid. Believe in yourself!

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: I'm going to cast a special spell on you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. That wasn't good at all.
I was completely out of tune.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But that really takes me back...
Rui and I used to practice in that park a lot.

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line:
Don't look down. Look up at the sky.
See? There's a beautiful rainbow!

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: Doesn't it make you want to sing?

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: Hehehe! This is fun...!

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: One day, I'll do this on a real stage!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was having so much fun back then...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'd even go to the library or to Rui's house and have an adult read screenplays to me...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Everything changed after just that one mistake...)

rows.Speaker: Little Nene's Voice
rows.Line: Would you like to fly into the sky with me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I guess I pressed the play button again... I'd better stop it.

rows.Speaker: Little Nene's Voice
rows.Line: Don't be afraid. Believe in yourself!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My acting and singing were so bad, but why does it feel so uplifting...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It looks like I was having so much fun too...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I looked so happy and was singing my heart out... I can't seem to look away...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wait... Is that it?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Having fun while performing...? Just singing my heart out is the difference?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I wasn't afraid of making mistakes back then. I just enjoyed getting in character and losing myself while singing.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But... It's not like that anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That one failure is always on my mind, and now I'm worried about beating her. I can't just blindly enjoy acting.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No matter how well I sing, it's not coming from my heart and can't be much fun to listen to...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then the answer is simple... I have to enjoy what I'm doing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The best thing for this show is for me to have as much fun as possible!

rows.Speaker: Little Nene's Voice
rows.Line: I'm going to cast a special spell on you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Mom!

rows.Speaker: Nene's Voice
rows.Line: I'm going to practice singing now. I hope you don't mind the noise.

rows.Speaker: Nene's Mom's Voice
rows.Line: Wait, now? It's very late so try to keep it down.

rows.Speaker: Nene's Mom's Voice
rows.Line:
The neighbors might complain...
Well, not the Kamishiros, but you know...

rows.Speaker: Nene's Voice
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll try to keep it down.
